access.general.name: Trouble getting into account
access.general.description: Reviewers say the app blocks access to their account and shows too many ads.

access.login_failure.name: Password not accepted
access.login_failure.description: Reviewers report the app rejects their password when they try to log in.

billing.charges_refund.name: Premium changes feel unfair
billing.charges_refund.description: Reviewers feel a recent update pushed features behind premium, making the app useless without paying.

billing.premium_paywall.name: Basic features locked behind premium
billing.premium_paywall.description: Reviewers say skipping, song choice, and queue controls now require a premium subscription, which they find unfair.

catalog.general.name: Missing songs and genres
catalog.general.description: Reviewers say the app lacks certain music, including gospel and reggae, and many songs are unavailable.

catalog.lyrics.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
catalog.lyrics.description: Reviewers report lyrics sometimes fail to appear, and availability differs between songs.

downloads.download_failure.name: Downloads get stuck
downloads.download_failure.description: Reviewers say songs stall while downloading in the background until they reopen Spotify.

downloads.offline_play.name: Offline playback not working
downloads.offline_play.description: Reviewers report that offline listening does not work for them.

other.general_dislike.name: General negative sentiment
other.general_dislike.description: Reviewers express dissatisfaction with the app overall, often criticising recent updates without specifics.

playback.connectivity.name: Wi-Fi connection problems
playback.connectivity.description: Reviewers say the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality is poor.

playback.crash_freeze.name: App crashes after update
playback.crash_freeze.description: Reviewers report the app crashes or will not open following a recent update.

playback.general.name: Google Assistant playback fails
playback.general.description: Reviewers say Google Assistant reports playing a playlist but the songs do not start.

playback.lag_loading.name: Stuck on loading screen
playback.lag_loading.description: Reviewers say the app freezes on the loading or logo screen and never finishes starting.

playback.stops_pauses.name: Playback stops unexpectedly
playback.stops_pauses.description: Reviewers report music stops halfway and does not resume where it left off, starting a new song instead.

usability.ads.name: Too many ads
usability.ads.description: Reviewers complain of frequent, loud ads between songs, especially for free users without premium.

usability.playlist_library.name: Home screen and playlist changes
usability.playlist_library.description: Reviewers dislike the new home screen layout and unwanted recommendations cluttering their playlists.

usability.shuffle_queue.name: Can't play chosen songs
usability.shuffle_queue.description: Reviewers say songs shuffle randomly within playlists and they cannot choose or skip tracks freely.

usability.ui_layout.name: Player controls and autoplay issues
usability.ui_layout.description: Reviewers report autoplaying audio elements with no setting to disable them, and missing basic player controls like rewind.
